name: V1.4
body:
#V1.4

### ⚔️ PvP Nemesis & KOS Tracking

Added two new PvP relationship stats to the bottom row of the stats panel:

* **Last BG Nemesis** – The player who killed you the most in your most recent battleground.
* **KOS Enemy (All-Time)** – The player who has killed you the most across all tracked battlegrounds.

### 📊 How It Works

While you're in **Alterac Valley**, **Warsong Gulch**, or **Arathi Basin**, the addon now:

* Tracks the last hostile player to damage you (within a 15-second window).
* Credits that player when you die.
* Counts repeated deaths to build a per-match tally.

When you leave the battleground:

* Your top killer becomes **Last BG Nemesis**.
* The results are added to your persistent all-time statistics to determine your **KOS Enemy**.

All data is saved **per character**.

### 🧹 New Slash Command

You can now reset your killer history at any time with:

```
/rpvp kos
```

or

```
/rpvp clearkos
```

Both commands clear all tracked killer statistics.
